title: Grow the economy

predict.q: AD is fixed. Start: LRAS at **1000**, price level **100**. Productivity rises **10%**; the labour force is unchanged. In the long run, what happens?

options.s: Real output rises and the price level rises
options.fb: AD has not changed. More output along the same AD comes with a lower price level.
Vertical means output does not depend on the price level. The curve itself still shifts when capacity grows.

options.s: Real output rises and the price level falls
options.fb: LRAS shifts right to 1100 and the PPC out; along the same AD the price level falls to 90.

options.s: The price level rises; real output stays at 1000
options.fb: Productivity raises capacity, so LRAS moves; output does not stay at 1000.

task: Move the productivity slider, then the labour-force slider. Watch LRAS and the PPC move together.

target.do: Move the productivity slider to +10%, then press Check.

takeaway: More capacity shifts LRAS right and the PPC out; with AD unchanged, real output rises (1000 → 1100) and the price level falls (100 → 90).
